title: Amplified-machine configuration probability
statement: Let $N$ be a finite nondeterministic Turing machine over the Boolean alphabet, let $os$ be a Boolean, let $x$ be a finite Boolean input, let $B$ be a natural number, let $l$ be a label, let $\sigma$ be a register state, and let $p$ be rational. The predicate holds when the probability of the configuration with label $l$, register vector of $\sigma$, and no output, on input $x$, in the machine obtained by applying the amplification construction with parameters $cS,F,os$ to the disjunction of $N$, satisfies the register bound $B$, is $p$.
hypotheses_covered: A finite nondeterministic Turing machine $N$ over the Boolean alphabet
